1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein __said light emitting diodes are mounted on said columnar body such that light is emitted radially outward from said columnar body__.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein said optic element is configured to disperse light emitted from said diodes__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes __a phosphor material that converts wavelengths of light emitted by said diodes__.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and are configured to provide thermal dissipation and light transmission__.

7. (Original)

8. (Original)

9. (Original)

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and is positioned to emit light radially outward from said face__.

11. (Original)

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin, each optic element overlapping a respective said diode and configured to disperse light emitted therefrom__.

13. (Original)

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises __a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and regulating power delivery to said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light __in a direction substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body __such that light is emitted radially outward from said body__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __such that light is emitted radially outward from said body__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.
